name: docs-claim-check
tagline_zh: 写代码的顺手工具：docs-claim-check。英文简介见下。
desc_en: Check whether the claims in public-facing documentation (README, release notes, install/usage docs) are supported by the evidence the user provides — files, manifests, logs, and command outputs supplied in the conversation. Produces per-claim findings with a confidence label (verified / unsupported / stale-suspected / needs-human) and an explicit "input scope reviewed" statement. Advisory only. Us
